newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex shares jump on Bis buy.
newsitem.headline: Vendex shares jump on Bis buy.

text.p: Shares in Dutch retail and business services group Vendex International NV rose sharply on Monday when trading was resumed at 1100 GMT after the company said it was buying French temporary employment agency Bis.
Vendex was suspended at Friday's close of 76.80 guilders before the Amsterdam exchange opened on Monday and stood up 7.70 guilders at 84.50 shortly after trading resumed.
"It is a very good takeover for them and I think the shares will do well on the back of it," one Amsterdam dealer said.
Vendex said it would buy the founding Negro family's 60 percent share in Bis for 490 francs a share in a deal it said would give a moderate boost to its 1997/98 earnings per share.
It added it was considering a separate listing on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange for its business services decision after the deal.
"That is also a positive move," the dealer said.
